answer: Invariant: no identity mints a pearl without occupying a unique slot in the shared lagoon, so N identities cost N sequential proofs. Holds because (1) the lagoon calendar exposes exactly one slot per fixed interval, and two claims on one slot collide, burning both, and (2) each pearl must chain the prior slot's digest, forcing real elapsed work, while bonded ivory is slashed on collision. Sybils can fork but pay serial time plus stake per fake node.
